summary: Comprehensive testing of JudgyGPT theme toggle, anonymous chat, token packages, and Stripe checkout integration. All 13 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed - theme toggle works correctly, landing page loads with light theme, anonymous chat functions with 5 free message limit, quick prompts populate input, navigation works, and pricing page shows 3 token packages with Buy buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: Theme toggle implementation is correct - uses localStorage for persistence and CSS variables for theming
Anonymous chat correctly enforces 5 message limit per session
Token packages API returns correct data (starter/growth/power)
Stripe checkout integration working - creates valid checkout URLs
New users correctly receive 50 free tokens on signup
seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created during testing with unique UUIDs for auth and checkout tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified working: 1) Theme toggle (Sun/Moon icon) switches between light/dark mode, 2) Landing page loads with warm light theme by default, 3) Anonymous chat works with 5 free messages limit, 4) Quick prompt buttons populate input field, 5) Sign In navigates to /login, 6) Login/Register pages have theme toggle and display correctly, 7) Token packages API returns 3 packages (starter/growth/power), 8) Pricing page shows all packages with Buy buttons, 9) Token checkout creates valid Stripe URL, 10) /api/chat/anonymous works for unauthenticated users, 11) /api/tokens/balance returns token count for authenticated users, 12) Theme preference persists in localStorage
